Use case: precise-object-edit / style-transfer. This is the ONLY targeted revision of a fantasy RPG portrait. Input 1 is the v1 portrait to revise; input 2 is original identity/color reference; inputs 3–6 are Mara/Iwo/Leiya/Tore coarse-pixel style references only. KEEP the same character, age, hair/beard identity, head orientation, costume colors and actual transparent margins. Substantively REDRAW the lower face-to-collar transition: the neck is too tall. Bring the narrow collar up immediately under the jaw, visible bare neck only about 7–9 pixels on a 74x100 logical grid, not a long bust. Do not shorten by chopping off the bottom canvas. Use released space to enlarge the FACE modestly while retaining all hair/hat/ears fully inside real transparent 3px top/side and 2px bottom margins. Portrait remains one tightly cropped huge head with only a small collar sliver, no shoulders/chest.
Use broad hard connected pixel clusters, big nose and cheekbone planes, dark compact eyes. Shrink pale sclera into tiny muted dark warm-gray slits, no bright white patches. Reduce fine parallel hair/crease striping; do not add texture. Limited earthy roughly 24–32 colors, transparent RGBA, no antialiasing or dithering. No labels/text/frames/props, no background. Never add a beard to a clean-shaven face or remove an existing beard. This is an image-generation revision, not a resize of the previous image.
Saler / 桑勒 / SKO-NPC-SALER is about FORTY: retain mature slightly loose cheek skin, deep smile folds, thin dark mustache/jaw beard, narrow long face and prominent nose, brown swept side hair under compact dark-plum soft medieval merchant cap with little ocher tally stitches. Keep cap/hair silhouette complete but simplify and slightly reduce vertical cap bulk to favor the face. Specific expression correction: relax the raised INNER brow to near horizontal; keep vigilant sideways glance and restrained polite asymmetric HALF-SMILE. He is a guarded professional pricing a deal, not worried, mournful or angry. Keep dark-plum collarless outer edge and mustard-ochre rounded slit inner collar in a tiny strip right beneath jaw. Current expression may soften only enough to lose the worried raised inner brow; don't give a broad friendly grin.
